digest.component_or_area: reconciler dispatch / binding store / outbound differ
propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries lack jira_key, yet the sole producer _compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes only emits when entries carry jira_key.
The deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination ADR 0028 para 2 relies on is already implemented twice and both live: outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py, both verified on production DC.

rebar resurrects hard-deleted issues eventually through binding retirement: after 3 confirmed-404 note_absent calls, _retire removes the binding, the local ticket becomes unbound, and outbound_differ creates a fresh Jira issue.

The operator ruling forbids resurrection of deliberately-deleted Jira issues; prior art (Unito, Kubernetes reconcilers) supports this; the implementation guard prevents outbound create when the local ticket has a retired binding.
BindingStore.unretire(jira_key) provides a reversible escape hatch: drops the key from both the in-memory retired set and bindings-retired.json so the local ticket can be recreated on the next pass.

The dead chain must be deleted (not wired) because re-enabling the legacy snapshot-differ arms would duplicate work already owned by outbound_differ and binding_walk per their documented division of labour.
